meta.name: Alethe Agents — extracted visual and interaction system
meta.fidelity_target: system-level reconstruction with a living specimen page
meta.method_summary: Live browser inspection at 1363x936 DPR 1, full-page visual capture, DOM/accessibility snapshot, computed-style sampling, stylesheet rule inspection, safe theme/use-case/hover/keyboard probes, and source-skill provenance.

limitations: Cloud browser exposed one desktop viewport; direct viewport resizing was not available in the inspection surface.
Long-page screenshot is a compositional reference, not proof of off-screen animation timing.
Runtime CSS is observed from the deployed build; original source files and design files were not supplied.

principles.name: Technical frame
principles.statement: Content sits inside a centered 1280px frame with hatched side rails, hairline borders, and corner registration marks.

principles.name: Operational contrast
principles.statement: Near-black surfaces, high-white display type, low-contrast metadata, and a single vivid accent make system state feel instrument-like.

principles.name: Proof through interface
principles.statement: Product claims are demonstrated with terminal panes, state dots, project trees, grids, and a live orchestration canvas rather than only marketing copy.

principles.name: Theme as accent
principles.statement: Theme selection preserves the dark structural system and swaps the accent token plus its dim companion.

principles.name: Dense details, quiet rhythm
principles.statement: Large negative space and display-scale type are balanced by compact monospace labels, tiny status dots, and dense application mocks.

content_style.notes: The living report uses neutral specimen copy rather than reproducing source marketing copy.

exceptions.statement: Hero type and subject intentionally overlap and exceed normal content-box rhythm.
The orchestration canvas uses a darker #070709 surface than the main page to separate interactive state from editorial content.

gaps.statement: A matched mobile runtime capture was not possible in the available cloud browser surface. Mobile rules are source observations/inferences until rendered at a narrow viewport.
CSS durations and keyframes were inspected, but no frame-by-frame recording was available to measure actual render timing, stagger, or dropped frames.
Only the public landing route was in scope; authenticated application views and their states were not inspected.
Original source images, brand marks, and third-party tool logos were not reused in the living report.

additional_findings.statement: The visible theme interaction changes data-theme and writes --accent plus --accent-dim inline; the structural surface palette remains stable in the sampled states.
Status is a small visual grammar: color-coded dot, terse state word, and monospace task detail. This repeats across the canvas and application mockups.
Radial dot grids, diagonal side hatching, and registration corners act as environmental texture without competing with content.
The report preserves layout rules, tokens, behavior, and component anatomy while replacing source copy, artwork, wordmark imagery, and third-party logos with neutral specimens.
